note: The scripted demo (S5). Film time in seconds. cmds drive the real page (solver log, views, sliders, knob); camera / spot / captions are the film's own layers. Selectors are elements of xray.html; a camera 'fit' frames the union of its selectors. S5: captions = SCRIPT.md v1 with generous voicing slots; retimed to the voice next.

captions.zh: 这道黑影，是一颗 13 毫米的胆结石投下的。
captions.en: This dark stripe is cast by a gallstone, 13 millimetres across.

say.zh: 这道黑影，是一颗十三毫米的胆结石投下的。
say.en: This dark stripe is cast by a gallstone, thirteen millimetres across.

captions.zh: 拍下它的，不是 X 光，而是声音。
captions.en: No X-rays made this picture. Only sound.

captions.zh: 整台超声机，就装在这只探头里。
captions.en: The whole scanner fits inside this probe.

captions.zh: 插在手机上，就能用。
captions.en: Plug it into a phone, and it works.

captions.zh: 剖开探头的前端，最外面是一层硅胶声透镜。
captions.en: Cut open the nose. On the outside sits a silicone lens.

captions.zh: 透镜下面是两层匹配层，再下面，是一排压电晶片。
captions.en: Under it are two matching layers, and under those, a row of piezo crystals.

captions.zh: 晶片后面的背衬块，让每一次振动很快停下来。
captions.en: The backing block behind them makes every ring stop fast.

captions.zh: 通上电，晶片一震，就发出 3.5 兆赫的声脉冲。
captions.en: A voltage kicks the crystals, and they ring out a 3.5 megahertz pulse.

say.zh: 通上电，晶片一震，就发出三点五兆赫的声脉冲。
say.en: A voltage kicks the crystals, and they ring out a three point five megahertz pulse.

captions.zh: 每个晶片都晚一点点出发，声波就汇聚到同一个焦点。
captions.en: Each crystal fires a little later than the next, so the waves meet at one focus.

captions.zh: 声音每遇到一层组织，就弹回来一点回声。
captions.en: Every boundary in the body sends a little echo back.

captions.zh: 机器假定声速是每秒 1540 米。
captions.en: The scanner assumes sound travels 1540 metres a second.

say.zh: 机器假定声速是每秒一千五百四十米。
say.en: The scanner assumes sound travels fifteen hundred and forty metres a second.

captions.zh: 所以回声晚 13 微秒，就是深了 1 厘米。
captions.en: So an echo 13 microseconds later means 1 centimetre deeper.

say.zh: 所以回声晚十三微秒，就是深了一厘米。
say.en: So an echo thirteen microseconds later means one centimetre deeper.

captions.zh: 结石在 7 厘米深的地方，回声 91 微秒就回来了。
captions.en: The stone is 7 centimetres down. Its echo is back in 91 microseconds.

say.zh: 结石在七厘米深的地方，回声九十一微秒就回来了。
say.en: The stone is seven centimetres down. Its echo is back in ninety-one microseconds.

captions.zh: 声音过不去结石，下面就没有回声，只剩一道黑影。
captions.en: Sound cannot get through the stone. Below it there is no echo, only a shadow.

captions.zh: 一条线接一条线扫过去，一秒钟能画 38 张。
captions.en: Line after line sweeps across, 38 pictures every second.

say.zh: 一条线接一条线扫过去，一秒钟能画三十八张。
say.en: Line after line sweeps across, thirty-eight pictures every second.

captions.zh: 换成 9 兆赫，波长只有 0.17 毫米，画面更细。
captions.en: Switch to 9 megahertz. The wavelength drops to 0.17 millimetres, and the picture gets finer.

say.zh: 换成九兆赫，波长只有零点一七毫米，画面更细。
say.en: Switch to nine megahertz. The wavelength drops to zero point one seven millimetres, and the picture gets finer.

captions.zh: 但是声音衰减得更快，7 厘米以下就看不见了。
captions.en: But the sound fades faster, and below 7 centimetres there is nothing left.

say.zh: 但是声音衰减得更快，七厘米以下就看不见了。
say.en: But the sound fades faster, and below seven centimetres there is nothing left.

captions.zh: 在 CT 上，很多结石和胆汁几乎一样，常常被漏掉。
captions.en: On CT, many gallstones look almost like bile, and they are often missed.

say.en: On C T, many gallstones look almost like bile, and they are often missed.

captions.zh: 超声也有盲区，声音穿不过充满空气的肺。
captions.en: Ultrasound has a blind spot too. Sound cannot cross the air in the lungs.

captions.zh: 回到这颗结石，下面那道黑影，就是声音过不去的地方。
captions.en: Back to the stone. The shadow below is where the sound could not go.

captions.zh: 剖面影像工坊，让看不见的原理被看见。
captions.en: Cutaway Works. Making the invisible visible.
